comparison.objective: Install and secure four toy-car wheels, then verify free rotation and rolling.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated wheel alignment and attachment, one-arm workpiece reorientation, and functional checking.
comparison.success_condition: All four wheels are secured, turn freely, and permit the car to roll; setup and quantitative scoring are missing.
comparison.reason: Tests repeated assembly and post-installation function, not removal of HELICOIL tangs while preserving installed inserts.
